name: Fisher Hut
desc: There's a hut and few palms on the island as well as an boat spawner. Inside of the hut, you can buy a Fishing Rod for 30 notes and Chum for 10 notes, also [Mortus](entity:mortus) can be found here. Next to the hut is a Gear cabinet. If you go left from the hut, you'll pass trough a small alley and youl'll be at a fishing spot.
additional_info:
-   Generally, this place is good for Fishing, because people don't come here often and if you fish at the fishing spot you're tehnically uninteruptable.
-   You can set up to 3 Monster Baits here alongside being able to buy them here.
-   The place is in the open sea but still secluded by a mountain
